prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A3.4 prescribed display paths with the indexed frequency ratio 3:2:1 and independently selected remaining A3 coordinates.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0.35 is illustrative.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; each positive h_a separates the endpoint orbit centers.
The frequencies (0.75, 0.5, 0.25) instantiate the indexed A3.4 ratio 3:2:1; the radii are independently prescribed.
Normalized linear axis interpolation is illustrative between the taxonomy-defined endpoints.
